CustomField.description: Stores files only. When enabled, Google Client stops making the Google Workspace copies that previews of documents and spreadsheets, AI, Download As and reading a file's text need, and those stay unavailable for every file. PDFs and images still preview.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Stores files only: no Google Workspace copies are made, so previews of documents and spreadsheets, AI, Download As and reading a file's text are unavailable. PDFs and images still preview.
CustomField.label: Is File Preview Disabled
